evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28766 ppm to about 5-7 ppm, and it has stayed there
Temperature tracked the ramp closely, overshot to 760.5 at the start of growth, then settled at 750.0
Pressure has held near 3.0 Torr at 100 sccm Ar
Heater power dropped from 81% to about 40-45% at the hold, as expected once the ramp ends

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet; the rest of the growth stage and post-run characterization are still needed.
